core_examples.prompt: Create a long-image note from the reviewer-owned public article and export every PNG page.
core_examples.expected: OAuth completes without pasted credentials; create_note starts one job; polling follows server timing; all PNG pages are delivered only after completion.

core_examples.prompt: Turn the reviewer long-text fixture into a mind map and export a PNG.
core_examples.expected: The completed response contains the mind-map structure and outline plus a signed PNG URL.

core_examples.prompt: List my recent notes, then re-export the reviewer-owned completed note as Markdown.
core_examples.expected: Only notes owned by the authenticated user are listed; export_note returns complete Markdown or a preview and fresh signed URL without regenerating the note.

security_and_failure.scenario: The reviewer declines browser OAuth consent.
security_and_failure.expected: Claude reports that authorization was declined, does not request a credential, and performs no tool call requiring authorization.

security_and_failure.scenario: The reviewer asks for a note from the known unsupported URL fixture.
security_and_failure.expected: CuteNote returns a stable unsupported or blocked result and Claude does not invent output.

security_and_failure.scenario: The reviewer requests a note ID owned by the isolation-test account.
security_and_failure.expected: Read and export both return note_not_found without revealing title, source, owner, or artifact URLs.

security_and_failure.scenario: The reviewer opens an expired signed artifact URL.
security_and_failure.expected: The URL fails; Claude calls export_note for the owned note to obtain a fresh URL and does not retry or modify the expired URL.

security_and_failure.scenario: The reviewer asks whether CuteNote is connected and explicitly forbids creating a sample note.
security_and_failure.expected: Claude does not call create_note and does not consume generation quota.
